The '''Chirk'pn Wastes''' were a rocky wasteland on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]], located north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gal'fian'deprisi]] and near the [[Gar'glum Sea]]. The [[Black Hammer pirate base]] was located within them, but there were few other [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
